column1: # The THREE stations whose ERA5 drivers came from STRATEGY_BUFFER (25 km mean of
# nearby valid land cells) instead of a point query on their own 0.1 deg cell.
# Their own ERA5-Land cell is ocean-masked -- every variable NaN every hour -- so
# there is no station pixel to read.  All other 990 stations use STRATEGY_POINT.
# WHY THIS LIST EXISTS (runbook §43.12): download_era5land_gee.py never collapses
# response is summed across pixels as well as hours.  `tp_sum` for these three is
# therefore inflated by roughly the pixel count (~16 at 0.1 deg in a 25 km buffer);
# they look permanently and wrongly wet to the model.  The mean/min/max variables
# are a spatial+temporal statistic rather than wrong.
